title: Dogfood README HQ on its own homepage
summary: Use a dedicated workspace to draft the README HQ main-branch homepage. Capture where the guide helps or leaves a reader without a next step.

origin.source: README HQ self-use discussion and public homepage issue #1.

benefits: Gives maintainers a concrete example of using the template from draft through review.
risks: A self-test covers one repository and leaves external adoption behavior to later trials.

evidence.claim: The published guide defines the draft and publication workflow.
